tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ tshe bdag dkyil chog lag len ni/ tshig bdun/ bdag bskyed kyi tshul du las byang tshar gcig dang*/ spro na tshogs 'khor yang bya/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs rim du bsdus nas rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gzung*/ sngags drug phyag drug yul phyogs dang sa phyogs= sogs/ mdzod cig bsil rol/ na mo/ drin can rtsa ba dang= sogs/ brlag par 'gyur ro/ hūm̐/ sa phyogs= gzhan du dengs/ e ring dang*/ sum bha na= sogs/ bsil rol/ slob dpon gyis/ a mṛ ta= dbu mdzad kyis/ swa bhā wa= sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐= sogs/ shabta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsil rol/ slob dpon gyis tshom bu bsang*/ dbu mdzad ky-is sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las phag= sogs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhi khro rab 'byams gdangs/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni= sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rang rgya/ slar yang*/ lag g.yas phreng rgya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ arghaṃ rgya bcas/ shabta āḥhūm̐/ bsil rol/ ba lingta sogs la/ thod rgya bcas lan gsum/ sa gdangs/ skyobs pa sangs rgyas= lha mo dga' ba'i= 'dur/ rang bzhin du gyur/ bsil rol ring*/ slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la bskor ste byang shar nas dbus su 'khod/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha= sogs/ zhi khro rab 'byams gdangs/ hūm̐/ rang byung ye shes= sngags mthar chag chag g.yon bskor/ slob dpon chas su bzhugs nas/ e nyid stong pa= sogs/ gtso bo rgyan lha dang bcas pa'i nga rgyal gzung*/ sngags rgyas drangs bstim/ mchod bstod bzlas pa cung zad bya/ e ring bdun/ lce (386)hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkhar= sogs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥ sngags rgyas mchod bstod/ rdor dril spos 'dzin/ sa gdangs/ hūm̐/ ma lus phyogs rnams= sogs nas/ bstsal du gsol/ bar lan gsum/ 'dur/ zhes gsol= sbyin par bsam/ de bar slob dpon gyis gsungs/ slob dpon gyis hūm̐ bzhis byin bsdus la/ slob ma rnams zhwa phrag bkal gyis bzhengs nas/ dbu mdzad kyis bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las arghaṃ=

bsil rol mthar sum rdung*/ 'dur/ slob dpon zhal phyogs so sor 'khod dgos/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi= dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bsil rol/ sum/ 'dur/ i daṃ= chos dbyings ngang las= bsil rol/ sum rdung*/ shar gyi rol mo rkyang bas/ dgra lha g.yang 'bod gdangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa= tshigs bcad gcig gi bshad du gsol/ bsil rol sum rdung*/ lho pas/ mnyam nyid thams cad= bsil rol/ nub pas sum rdung*/ zhi ba chos mchog= bsil rol/ byang pas sum rdung*/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po= bshad du gsol/ bsil rol/ slob dpon gyis/ rang nyid phyag rgya= sogs nas/ rdo rje rgya gram du= bsam/ zhes pa gsungs/ zhwa bzhes/ rol chen bcas/ thugs sgrub dbyangs/ hūm̐/ lus ngag sems la= tshig dang po gnyis la rkang g.yas btsugs nas rnga g.yon du bsdabs/ nga ni khro rgyal sogs/ tshig gnyis g.yas tshar/ tshig rjes ma gnyis la g.yas g.yon gnyis 'gres/ slob dpon gyis/ gang su dag= brlag par bya'o/ chen rdung drag 'bud gsum la/ dang por yungs kar/ gnyis pa rdo rje'i 'gros/ gsum par rdo rje nang bstan g.yas bskor gcig (387) byang shar mtshams su sngags brgya tsam gyis bgegs bkug la/ phur pa slob dpon gyis bsang*/ dbu mdzad kyis sbyang*/ thams cad kyis/ stong pa'i ngang las phur pa= phur pa g.yon gyis gzung*/ g.yas pas tho ba brdung zhing gdab la/ oṃ gha gha= bsil rol/ tshom bu khod/ slob dpon khrir 'khod/ e nyid stong pa chos 'byung= nas/ bstod pa yan/ sku gsung thugs sngags brgya re/ e ring nye gcig e/ bcom ldan phyag rgya= sogs mchod pa dang*/ chos dbyings= sogs bstod/ ye shes lha tshogs= sogs dang*/ ma 'byor= sogs kyis bshags pa bcas/ slob dpaun shar lhor 'khod/ rdor dril spos thogs/ hūm̐/ gnyis med ye shes= rdo rje khu tshur gan rkyal mthe chung sbrel/ mdzub mo rtse sprad pa smin mtshams su ldog hūm̐ badzra u tiṣṭha/ bsil rol tshom bu bsdu/

slob dpon dang las rdor gyis zhwa bzhes/ thig skud dang tshon sna lnga rnams/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las= sogs/ arghaṃ= mthar bsil rol/ chos sku nam mkha'= rigs lnga'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badzra su tra ma ti kra ma/ brgya rtsa bzla/ tshom yig byang nas g.yon bskor du srub/ rigs lnga yab yum= zhi khro rab 'byams gdangs/ hūm̐/ 'jig rten khams ni= sogs/ gcig tu gyur/ bsil rol/ slob dpon gyis/ stong gsum gdal ba= mkha' la gsal/ thig chen brgyad gdab/ gnam thig dang*/ sa thig gnyis gdab/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa/ slob dpon gyi thig gi ye shes pa hrīḥsgra'i phyag rgyas nam mkhar btegs pa'i 'og tu bzhugs la/ dbus kyi phur bur 'byung ba'i kha dog dang mthun (388) par tshon khra slob dpon gyis blugs la/ e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ/ tshon sna lnga bsres blugs la/ bhrūm̐/ zhes brjod/ thod pas gdab/ de nas dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bri/ zin nas rgyan bkram pa dang yo byad bsham/ sgrub mchod dngos gzhi'i nub dang po'i cho ga'i byin 'bebs dus nam mkhar btegs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstim mo/ gzhan gtor bzlog sogs phrin las gang yin dang sbyar zhing bya'o// bkra shis//
